gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-display: Fat tube-lettering with a big lowercase and a splayed c, drawn like bent neon with nothing held back. Noto Sans Display is the approachable counterweight, with its tall middle zone keeping every word easy to take in.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-play: Play keeps its upstrokes and downstrokes almost the same, with little gap between capitals and lowercase. And Tilt Neon sits above it as a single thread of glowing tubing, loud where the body is composed.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-port-lligat-sans: Port Lligat Sans reads tight and modern, its bowls left open on one side and its letters packed like pins in a cushion. But Tilt Neon's single-tip simplicity gives the pair its real punch, bold tubing over a quiet, compact line.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra reads as a plain sans with a prominent x-height, clean and businesslike in its manner. Ramabhadra's low contrast sits well under Tilt Neon, whose letters look bent from one length of tubing.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-rambla: Commanding tube letters from Tilt Neon take the top spot, their y tails as thick as the arms, while Rambla sits beneath with small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Shrink the heading and that glow fades fast.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-recursive: Recursive reads modern and friendly, a sans with a tall mean line and strokes that keep one thickness whichever way they turn. Tilt Neon's bent-tubing boldness is what stands out, though, loud over that steady text.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-roboto-condensed: Contemporary and tight, Roboto Condensed packs its words with barely visible gaps. Over a full page it glides under the eye like wire, while Tilt Neon's splayed c announces each heading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Modern restraint comes from Saira Semi Condensed, whose text looks magnified even at ordinary size. Saira Semi Condensed holds a steady weight word after word, leaving Tilt Neon's tube-like capitals to do all the shouting.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-secular-one: Tilt Neon's tube-like stroke never changes width, so its large lowercase and short ascenders look bent from glowing pipe. Secular One follows with a dominant midsection and no modulation, a dense, sturdy sans-serif texture.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans runs closely packed, with a high midline and an s that opens generously through its bends. Tilt Neon's one-nib boldness is the pair's loudest quality, a heavy glow over a slim, tight line.
